meta.warning: Every rate marked VERIFY_RATE must be replaced with the current official rate from NEPRA, OGRA or the company before this site is used for real estimates. Do not publish a numeric total as official while any rate is still VERIFY_RATE.
meta.how_to_update: Open data/tariffs.json, find the company, replace each VERIFY_RATE with a number (PKR), update last_updated and source_url, then redeploy. The calculator reads this file, so no JavaScript change is needed.

lesco.name: LESCO
lesco.source: NEPRA tariff determination and the company tariff schedule — verify the current SRO/notification.

charges.income_tax_note: Section 235 / further tax rules vary by consumer and bill history — fill from the official tariff note, do not guess.

notes: Protected status usually depends on average consumption over the previous months — confirm the current rule from the official tariff before publishing.
Peak / off-peak (time-of-use) rates apply only to TOU consumers. If this company page is for a normal domestic consumer, leave TOU blank and use the standard slabs.

charges.fixed_charge_note: Gas fixed charges differ by category and by protected / non-protected status.

notes: Gas slabs are in HM3. If your bill shows MMBTU, convert using the conversion factor printed on the bill, and note it on the page.
Many domestic gas consumers are billed bi-monthly. A two-month consumption figure must not be entered as a one-month figure.
